checkpoint_cas_adoption_bounded_history.statement: For the continuing GITHUB_CHECKPOINT_CAS registry-adoption work related to moose-test-repo #888/#913 only, accept the eight enumerated retained GitHub runs and PRs #321–#327 as sufficient bounded repository-owned historical evidence for the separate privileged-adoption review, rather than demanding recovery of deleted repository records as a prerequisite to that review. This decision recognizes a limited repository-owner evidence boundary, not complete historical coverage, authenticated original work enrollment, clearance of an existing denial, or permission to publish. The existing policy denial remains active until a separately authorized and verified policy adoption. Any external tool-safety denial or unresolved external authority/scope remains a hard stop; only its originating authority can clear it. No provider substitution or new work identity may evade a prior denial. Production publication requires separate authenticated work binding, authority verification, runtime and claim gates, and exact run approval.
